english: I disagree that unchanging things are both (1) a quality of a quality and (2) characteristic of what is characteristic of a quality. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider unchanging things. They are too an example of something which is both (1) a quality of a quality and (2) characteristic of what is characteristic of a quality. Because first of all, they are a quality of a quality; and secondly, they are characteristic of what is characteristic of a quality.
